questions.question: What is the ratio of the total exports of computers in 2015 and 2017 to the total exports of cosmetics in 2015 and 2018?
questions.solution:
Number of exports of computers in 2015 and 2017 = (400 + 500) × 24/100 = 216

Number of exports of cosmetics in 2015 and 2018 = (400 + 600) × 15/100 = 150

Required ratio = 216 : 150 = 36 : 25

questions.question: Total exports of cosmetics in four years is approximately what percent less than the total exports of Garments and Jewellery in 2015 and 2018?
questions.solution:
Total exports of cosmetics in four years are = (400 + 650 + 500 + 600) × 15/100 = 2150 × 15/100 = 322.5

Total exports of Garment and Jewellery in 2015 and 2018 = (400 + 600) × (28 + 8)/100 = 1000 × 36/100 = 360

Required percentage = (360 - 322.5)/360 × 100 = 10.4%

questions.question: Total exports of Jewellery in 2015, 2016 and 2018 are what percent of the total exports of textiles in 2017 and 2018?
questions.solution:
Total exports of jewellery in 2015, 2016 and 2018 = (400 + 650 + 600) × 8/100 = 132

Total exports of textiles in 2017 and 2018 = (500 + 600) × 25/100 = 275

Required percentage = 132/275 × 100 = 48%

questions.question: In 729 litres solution of acid and water, the ratio of acid and water is 7 : 2. How many litres of water must be added to it to get the solution in which the ratio of acid and water is 5 : 3?
questions.solution:
Quantity of acid in the solution = 729 × 7/9 = 567 litres

Quantity of water in the solution = 729 - 567 = 162 litres

Let quantity of added water be x, then

⇒ 567/(162 + x) = 5/3

⇒ 3 × 567 = 5 × 162 + 5x

⇒ 1701 = 810 + 5x

⇒ 5x = 1701 - 810

⇒ x = 178.2

∴ The quantity of added water is 178.2 litres.

questions.question: Let x and y be 3-digit numbers such that their difference is 729 and HCF is 81. What is the value of (x + y)?
questions.solution:
Let two numbers be 81x and 81y, then

⇒ 81 (x - y) = 729

⇒ (x - y) = 9

As we know,

Both numbers are in three digit, then x = 12, 11 or 10 and y = 3, 2 or 1

If we take 12 and 3 then HCF become more and if take 10 and 1 then number become 2 digit

Taking only = x = 11 and y = 2

Numbers are = 81 × 11, 81 × 2 = 891, 162

Sum of numbers are = 81 (11 + 2) = 81 × 13 = 1053

questions.question: The area of a circular park is very nearly equal to seven-fifteenth of the area of a triangular field having sides 110 m, 600 m, and 610 m. What is the diameter of the park? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides of the triangle are 110 m, 600 m, and 610 m.

Area of circular park = 7/15 × Area of the triangular field

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = 1/2 × Base × height 

Area of circle = πr² , where r → radius of the circle

**Calculation:**

As we know,

⇒ 610² = 110² + 600²

⇒ 372100 = 12100 + 360000

⇒ 372100 = 372100

Now, we can say the triangle is a right-angled triangle, then

Area of triangle = 1/2 × Base × height = 1/2 × 110 × 600 = 33000

Area of circular park = 7/15 × 33000

⇒ πr² = 15400

⇒ 22/7 × r² = 15400

⇒ r² = 15400 × 7/22

⇒ r = √(7 × 7 × 10 × 10)

⇒ r = 7 × 10

⇒ r = 70m

Diameter of circular park = 2 × 70 = 140

questions.question: A and B move towards each other at the same time at the speeds of 10 km/h and 20 km/h, respectively and the distance between them is 49 km. How much is the distance between them, in m, 5 minutes before they meet?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Speed of A and B are 10 km/hr and 20 km/hr respectively

Relative speed, if opposite direction = 10 + 20 = 30 km/hr

Now, distance covered in 60 mins = 30 km

So, distance covered in 5 mins = (30/60) × 5 km

⇒ 2.5 km = 2500 m

**∴ The distance between them 5 min before they meet is 2500 m**

questions.question: There are four different numbers. The average of the first three of them is four times the fourth number and the average of all the four numbers is 87.75. What is the average of the first three numbers?
questions.solution:
Let fourth number be x

Average of first 3 numbers = 4x

Sum of first 3 numbers = 3 × 4x = 12x

Average of 4 numbers = 87.75

Sum of 4 numbers = 87.75 × 4 = 351

⇒ 12x + x = 351

⇒ 13x = 351

⇒ x = 27

Average of first three numbers = 4 × 27 = 108

questions.question: The sum of incomes of A and B is Rs. 165000. A spends 70% and B spends 80% of their incomes. If savings of A is 25% more than that of B, then what is the difference between their incomes?
questions.solution:
Let Income of A and B are x and y respectively.

⇒ x × 30/100 = y × 20/100 × (125/100)

⇒ x/y = 5/6

⇒ x : y = 5 : 6

⇒ 5 + 6 = 11 unit

⇒ 11 unit = 165000

⇒ 1 unit = 15000

∴ Difference between income of A and B is 15000.

questions.question: The marked price of an article is 20% above the cost price. After allowing x% discount on the marked price, a shopkeeper loses 10%. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Let cost price of the article be Rs. 100

MP of the article = 100 × (120/100) = Rs. 120

SP of the article = 100 × 90/100 = Rs. 90

Discount = 120 - 90 = Rs. 30

Discount % = 30/120 × 100 = 25%

questions.question: The ratio of the number of boys and girls in a class is 2 : 3 and the average score in mathematics of all the students in the class is 54. The average score of boys is 50% more than the average score of girls. What is the average score of girls?
questions.solution:
Let average score of girls be 2x

Average score of boys = 2x × 3/2 = 3x

Ratio of boys and girls = 2 : 3

Let number of boys be = 2 and number of girls = 3

According to the question

⇒ 2 × 3x + 3 × 2x = 54 × 5

⇒ 6x + 6x = 270

⇒ 12x = 270

⇒ x = 270/12

Average score of girls = 2 × 270/12 = 45

questions.question: A boat goes a distance of 3 km upstream and 4(1)/(2) km downstream in 45 minutes, while it goes 3.6 km upstream and 2.4 km downstream in 39 minutes. The speed (in km/h) of the boat when going downstream is:
questions.solution:
Let speed of boat and stream be x km/hr and y km/hr,

Upstream speed = (x - y) km/hr

Downstream speed = (x + y) km/hr

According to the question

⇒ 3/(x - y) + 4.5/(x + y) = 45/60 --- (1)

⇒ 3.6/(x - y) + 2.4/(x + y) = 39/60 --- (2)

After multiply by 1.2 in equation (1) subtract equation (2) from equation (1)

⇒ 3/(x + y) = 1/4

⇒ x + y = 12 km/hr

∴ Downstream speed is 12 km/hr.

questions.question: If the rate of interest is 20% per annum, compounded yearly and the interest on a certain sum in the second year is Rs. 250, then what will be the interest on the same sum in the fifth year?
questions.solution:
Rate of interest = 20%

CI for second year = Rs. 250

CI for third year = 250 × 120/100 = Rs. 300

CI for fourth year = 300 × 120/100 = Rs. 360

CI for fifth year = 360 × 120/100 = Rs. 432

**Other method:**

CI of fifth year = 250 × 6/5 × 6/5 × 6/5 = Rs. 432

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 30 days. He completed 40% of the work and then left. B completed the remaining work in 21 days. Working together, A and B will complete 65% of the same work in:
questions.solution:
Let efficiency of A be 1 unit, then

Total work = 30

40% of the work = 30 × 40/100 = 12

Remaining work = 30 - 12 = 18

Let efficiency of B be x, then

⇒21x = 18

⇒ x = 18/21 = 6/7

Efficiency of A and B = 1 + 6/7 = 13/7

65% of the total work = 30 × 65/100 = 19.5

65% of the total work, A and B complete in = 19.5/(13/7) = 10.5 days

questions.question: A solid metallic cylinder of base radius 4 cm and height 5(1)/(3) cm is melted and recast into a sphere. What is the surface area of the sphere, in cm?
questions.solution:
Radius of cylinder r = 4 cm and height of cylinder h = 16/3 cm

Volume of sphere = 4/3 × πR³

Surface area of sphere = 4 πR²

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

According to the question

⇒ 4/3 × πR³ = πr²h

⇒ R³ = 4 × 4 × 16/3 × 3/4

⇒ R = 4 cm

Surface area of sphere = 4π × 4² = 64π cm²

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of A and B is 5 : 3 and 9 years ago, their ages were in the ratio 23 : 12. What will be the ratio of their ages 15 years from now?
questions.solution:
Ratio of present ages of A and B = 5x : 3x

According to the question

⇒ (5x - 9)/(3x - 9) = 23/12

⇒ 12 (5x - 9) = 23 (3x - 9)

⇒ 60x - 108 = 69x - 207

⇒ 69x - 60x = 207 - 108

⇒ 9x = 99

⇒ x = 11

15 years after age of A = 5 × 11 + 15 = 55 + 15 = 70

15 years after age of B = 3 × 11 + 15 = 33 + 15 = 48

Required ratio = 70 : 48 = 35 : 24

questions.question: If two-third of goods are sold at 25% profit, 20% are sold at 20% loss and rest at a profit of 20%, then there is a profit of Rs. 3312. The cost price of the goods is:
questions.solution:
Let there are 150 goods cost of each be 1 unit, then

Total CP of 150 goods = 150 unit

⇒ 2/3 of 150 = 100, 20% of 150 = 30 and Remaining goods = 150 - 100 - 30 = 20

Total SP of 150 goods = 100 × 5/4 + 30 × 4/5 + 20 × 6/5 = 125 + 24 + 24 = 173 unit

Profit = 173 - 150 = 23 unit

⇒ 23 unit = 3312

⇒ 1 unit = 144

⇒ 150 unit = 150 × 144 = Rs. 21600

 ∴Cost of price of goods is Rs. 21600.
